description:
Encode the consolidated transaction surface in the canonical public contracts and complete the comprehensive behavioral and structural release evidence on the sole repository-state engine. This is the sole leaf accountable for container criterion REQ-08 and completes Group B for the v1.0 source freeze.

## Background

With the repository-state architecture landed on main, the drift/repair validation and project invariant are complete sibling assurance tasks. This task supplies the public documentation and release evidence that the v1.0 source freeze consumes. No second implementation may appear during assurance. Current-tree review also found two release-facing defects that this task must close: validate/fix CLI failures hide actionable nested causes behind a generic outer context, and the GitHub security-audit workflow suppresses installation and Rust/Node audit failures despite @/charter/D-11.

## What to build

- Public contract updates: canonical human, JSON, schema, and MCP docs encode recoverable multi-target publication, drift diagnosis and repair, managed-region semantics, and absent-root publication. Human and machine failures retain actionable ambiguity and provenance causes. The claim and lease surface is documented unchanged. Contributor docs describe dependency-ordered direct-main delivery; retired integration-branch staging is historical evidence only. Git evidence stays orchestration-only with core Git-optional and claims Git-required (@/charter/D-4). Existing projection and schema consumers remain covered.
- Release security enforcement: make `.github/workflows/security-audit.yml` fail closed when cargo-audit installation, the Rust audit, or either Node audit fails. Preserve the canonical local dependency and secret gates; do not add a second audit authority or suppress findings.
- Comprehensive behavioral evidence: in-process and CLI/MCP/schema tests cover profile/config integration, multi-target rendering, shared-target composition, marker failures, manual derived-state drift, transactional repair, idempotence, concurrent mutation serialization, interruption recovery for external and internal journals, Git-free operation, root-publication races, and stable actionable human and JSON result contracts.
- Structural evidence: guards prove predecessor deletion, no command-local publisher or duplicate renderer, no compatibility seam, and no independently delivered intermediate package.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Human, JSON, schema, and MCP docs encode recoverable multi-target publication, drift diagnosis and repair, managed-region semantics, and absent-root publication; actionable nested failure causes survive CLI rendering; the claim and lease surface is documented unchanged; release security audits fail closed.
- [hard] REQ-02: In-process and CLI/MCP/schema tests cover profile/config integration, multi-target rendering, shared-target composition, marker failures, manual derived-state drift, transactional repair, idempotence, concurrent mutation serialization, interruption recovery, Git-free operation, root-publication races, and stable human and JSON contracts.
- [hard] REQ-03: Structural guards prove predecessor deletion, no command-local publisher or duplicate renderer, no compatibility seam, and no independently delivered intermediate package.

## Constraints

- Sole engine only: add no alternate renderer, serializer, capture path, publisher, or compatibility layer.
- Docs state current behavior only; before/after narration belongs in the CHANGELOG.
- Keep corrections narrow: use the existing CLI error envelope/error-chain model and existing audit commands rather than adding reporting or security frameworks.
- Out of scope (plan D19/D20): lease credential, claim-log, claim-command, and worktree/data-root binding redesign. The claim and lease surface remains unchanged.

Blast radius: canonical docs and public adapters, `.github/workflows/security-audit.yml`, cohesive release suites, and source-tree absence checks. See `dev/active/cdc840ad-plan.md` section 2 (project-local invariant and public fit; complete evidence) and plan decisions D12 and D16.
title: Document public contracts and complete release evidence
